SUEZ CANAL AUTHORITY PERIODICAL NO. (29/2026) ON 28/09/2026
Regarding the amending of item (3), para. (F) of Art. (92), page 179 of the Suez Canal Rules of Navigation – December 2020 edition
Article One:
Amending item (3), para. (F), art. (92), page (179) of the Suez Canal Rules of Navigation – December 2020 edition, to read as follows:
“In case of submitting the missing documents (pre-mentioned in point (1)) no later than the 3rd transit, transit dues of the previous transit(s) will be settled on the basis of the SC.N.T, given that the previous transit(s) was within six months starting from the next day of the vessel’s first Suez Canal transit.”
Article Two:
This periodical is applicable to “vessels that submit the required documents to settle the transit dues on the basis of Suez Canal Net Tonnage” starting from its issuance date.

SUEZ CANAL AUTHORITY PERIODICAL NO. (27/2026) ON 27/07/2026
Concerning the Amendment of circular no.(7/2020)concerning Passenger Ships & Cruise Ships(only with passengers on board)
Article One:
Suez Canal Authority decided to add the stoppage of Passenger Ships & Cruise Ships (only with passengers on board) at “Timsah Lake (to deal with the Suez Canal Marina for the purpose of tourism)” to the stoppage at Egyptian Red Sea ports and any consequences affecting the calculation of number of hours spent in Egyptian Red Sea ports and the calculation of rebate percentage as per the circular.
Article Two:
- This periodical is applicable to "Passenger Ships" & "Cruise Ships" (only with passengers onboard) stopping at “Timsah Lake (to deal with the Suez Canal Marina for the purpose of tourism)” starting this periodical’s date of issuance.

Night services :

Third :

SUEZ CANAL AUTHORITY PERIODICAL NO. (16/2026) ON 7-6-2026
Regarding the amendment of Circular No. (1/2022) Concerning (Laden/Ballast) “Crude Oil Tankers” [Rate (1) of the Transit Dues Schedule] passing the Suez Canal in both directions
Article One:
1) The surcharge levied on Laden “Crude Oil Tankers” [Rate (1L) of the Transit Dues Schedule] transiting the Suez Canal in both directions, is amended to be 37% of the Suez Canal normal transit dues rather than 25%.
2) The surcharge levied on ballast “Crude Oil Tankers” [Rate (1B) of the Transit Dues Schedule] transiting the Suez Canal in both directions, is amended to be 27% of the Suez Canal normal transit dues rather than 15%.
Noting that these surcharges are temporary and can be either amended or cancelled according to the “Maritime Industry” market conditions.
Article Two:
- This periodical is applicable to tankers transiting the Suez Canal from the 15th of July 2026.
.

SUEZ CANAL AUTHORITY CIRCULAR NO. (2/2026) ON 7-6-2026
Concerning (Laden/Ballast) “Containerships” [Rate (7) of the Transit Dues Schedule] transiting the Suez Canal in both directions
Article One:
(Laden/Ballast) “Containerships” [Rate (7) of the Transit Dues Schedule] transiting the Suez Canal in both directions will be charged with a surcharge of 12% from total Suez Canal transit dues (including normal transit dues in addition to surcharges for tiers of containers on weather deck).
Noting that these surcharges are temporary and can be either amended or cancelled according to the “Maritime Industry” market conditions.
Article Two:
- This circular is applicable to vessels transiting the Suez Canal from the 15th of July 2026.
.
